_notes: UQM 0.8.0's own battle engine, recorded by running battle.c's Battle as an encounter runs it (see tools/extract/golden/battle.c): TFB_SeedRandom from the seed, InitShips (the stars, five asteroids, the planet), each side's ship warping in (the enemy's first), then DoBattle's frames: ProcessInput, and RedrawQueue's PreProcessQueue (each element's step, moving, ProcessCollisions over UQM's own DrawablesIntersect and collide()), CalcView and PostProcessQueue, with UQM's process.c, collide.c, gravity.c, misc.c, weapon.c, ship.c, tactrans.c, init.c, status.c and shipstat.c; drawing, sound and music stubbed. Contact is found with the masks of the sheets (sheets, numbered; the big size's, as battle-masks.json has them) from the official content package (SHA-256 77d75ac25e6fb755a33c4ba3b38a7b7bc41fcbc02896891b0cc9ac9214b72eef); the medium and small sizes only count their frames (SetAbsFrameIndex takes an index round them). Everything else is code.

The ships are test ships (load_ship in battle.c): UQM's stock ship_preprocess and ship_postprocess with no callbacks of their own, flying the flagship's or the Ilwrath's sheets with its RACE_DESC's numbers (data/ships.json, changed where input says) and plain weapons made by weapon.c: weapons 1 a missile ahead (initialize_missile from the ship's weapon sheet at its facing), 2 a homing missile ahead (turning a facing towards TrackShip's target every track_wait + 1 frames), 4 a laser ahead (initialize_laser, laser_range pixels), 8 six missiles round the ship (facing + i * 8 / 3) instead; life, speed, hits, damage and offset are the missiles' (offset the laser's too): the flagship's blaster's numbers or the Ilwrath's hellfire's.

input: seed (TFB_SeedRandom's), zoom (smooth, UQM's default TFB_SCALE_TRILINEAR, or step), runaway (STARBASE_AVAILABLE set: side 0 can retreat), the planet's sheets, each side's ship, fleet (how many of its ship each side has, 1 each without), steps [frames, side 0's keys, side 1's] in BATTLE_INPUT_STATE (1 left, 2 right, 4 thrust, 8 weapon, 16 special, 32 escape), events [frame, side, target, crew]: AbandonShip called on side's ship towards target's before that frame. Some battles' keys were made by a pilot steering at the planet, the other ship or an asteroid; they're recorded as keys.
stars: InitGalaxy's stars (log_star_array: 30 big, 60 medium, 90 small, each block sorted by y), [x, y] each, before MoveGalaxy moves them.

frames: the first after the ships are spawned (before any frame), then one after each DoBattle: [TFB_Random's seed, the camera's scroll this frame (CalcView's dx, dy, added to every element), zoom_out, the view (0 stable, 1 scrolled, 2 zoomed; -1 before the first frame), SpaceOrg x and y (the view's corner), ships, elements, draws]. ships: each side's ships in its queue, each [crew_level and energy_level (SHIP_INFO's: the status panel's), ShipFacing, energy_counter, weapon_counter, special_counter, cur_status_flags, 1 if it has an element], or null without a RACE_DESC (not yet picked, or freed). elements: the display list from its head, each [state_flags, life_span, crew_level (hit_points), mass_points, turn_wait, thrust_wait, the velocity's TravelAngle, vector, fract, error and incr (width then height), current x, y, next x, y] as Super Melee's netplay checksum (checksum.c) takes them, then [its sheet's number, frame index, playerNr, the primitive's type (7 none), 1 if a filled stamp in black (cloaked), its slot in the list's table (its handle, 1 to 150) and its hTarget's (0 none)]. draws: each TFB_Random this frame, by the UQM function that drew it.

After the first full frames (full, counting the first), a frame is [seed, scroll x, y, zoom_out, view, SpaceOrg x, y, the number of elements, the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of [ships, elements, draws] as compact JSON (no spaces)]. ended: whether the battle ended (a side out of ships) before the steps did.
